about: One entry per series folder under images/. Written during the describing pass; edit freely.

series.name: Superland
series.summary: Thickly painted cubist cartoon worlds with heavy black outlines: crowds of globe headed and hash faced figures, striped spheres, splashes, rockets and giant faces in the sky. The founding vocabulary for everything after.

series.name: Magicbear
series.summary: Graffiti style panels on raw plywood about a bear character, with bubble lettering that fills every gap.

series.name: Commissions
series.summary: Pieces made for people: wide wordscape panels, Superland style oils, a spray painted name canvas, and the 2021 digital Cliffs of Volcano Ball Lake that seeded the Colorlands.

series.name: Towns
series.summary: Small square paintings of pastel towns and their residents: hooded pod figures, dinosaurs, dragons, vehicle creatures. Includes three group portraits and the Floating Earth Town.

series.name: Cactuses
series.summary: Sketchbook studies of cactuses as creatures, photographed on a table, plus two oil paintings that grow out of them.

series.name: Airbrush
series.summary: Stencil airbrush experiments: bark patterns, a bike stencil in five colourways, Eastern Parkway in four, a totem in four, and two ink and airbrush landscapes that prefigure the Colorlands.

series.name: Characters
series.summary: Twelve inch airbrush sheets of the hooded pod people: character sheets, city living, country living, and colour versions.

series.name: Screenprints
series.summary: A parody psychology apparatus ad, a line drawing for a print, and a reproduction of a 1930s airport poster.

series.name: Crowds
series.summary: Panels packed edge to edge with horned, toothed, one eyed monsters, and four mirrored reassembled crowds on joined panels.

series.name: Desertland
series.summary: Flat pastel desert landscapes of pods, blob figures and flying pods, Superland after a decade of rest.

series.name: Generative
series.summary: Process pieces made from the scribble underlayers and hut textures of the Colorlands drawings, one laid over a Brooklyn street.

series.name: Colorlands
series.summary: Candy coloured digital valleys crammed with creatures, drawn in Fresco with hand lettered titles. Includes the 2023 revisit of Volcano Ball Lake.

series.name: Scribble Pictures
series.summary: Street photographs of New York, Toronto and Vancouver with cartoon drawing over them: faceless people, scribbled signs, soft cars, and from late 2023 a growing population of creatures and invented clouds.
